Read GENEActiv Binary File

Source: R/acti_read_geneactiv.R
acti_read_geneactiv.Rd

Read GENEActiv Binary File

Usage

acti_read_geneactiv(
  path,
  start = 0,
  end = Inf,
  tz = "UTC",
  ...,
  verbose = TRUE
)

acti_read_geneactiv_header(path)

Arguments

path

Path to geneactiv binary file

start

where to start in the file, passed to GGIRread::readGENEActiv

end

where to end in the file, passed to GGIRread::readGENEActiv

tz

time zone for the data time, passed to desiredtz argument in GGIRread::readGENEActiv. If NULL or "", no time conversion is done.

...

additional arguments to pass to GGIRread::readGENEActiv()

verbose

print diagnostic messages, higher values = more verbosity.

Value

A tibble with attributes of a header, sample rate, and transformations

Examples

data = acti_read_cwa(acti_example_cwa())
